column1: # Upstream components of the Motanka Stack (source package motanka-stack).
# One line per component, tab-separated, in build order. Lines starting
# with '#' and empty lines are ignored.
#   name      component name; also the dpkg-source component name, so the
#             and debian/rules finds the source in the folder <name>/
#   url       tarball URL. Every tarball must have exactly one top-level
#             folder. Hyprland uses its release asset source-v<ver>.tar.gz,
#             which includes the git submodules (udis86, tracy).
#   sha256    SHA-256 of the tarball, or '-' if not pinned yet.
#   build     cmake | meson | autotools | lua | python-meson | headers |
#             cmake-tool (CMake built with the release's own CMake into a
#             build-only prefix; noble's CMake 3.28 is older than the 3.30
#   suites    noble | resolute | both: the suites that build the component
#   package   binary package for the component's programs and data, or '-'
#             for build-time only. Shared libraries (lib/*.so.*) always go
# Facts from spike S1 (design.md, "Spike results"): noble bundles wayland,
# libxkbcommon, libinput, libdisplay-info, libei, xcb-util-errors, sdbus-c++
# and Lua; resolute takes those from its archive.
# has 1.0.5, so it is built for resolute only until the owner decides how to
